products.description: See what any MCP server can actually touch — before you add it to your agent. No manifest? You still get the full blast-radius report. Add a manifest to also catch divergences. Query bundled business-DNA precedents via list/search/get tools. Conflict-free verification: no phone-home, Ed25519 attestations, and the same audit rules applied to our own tools via public governance.json.
products.limitations: Static analysis only; findings use confidence labels (observed-static, inferred). Default scan scope excludes tests/, docs/, examples/, scripts/, benchmarks/, .github/, and test_*.py unless --include-peripheral is set.

payment.deliverable: Human-delivered run output for the paid product_id, as specified in the fulfillment request. There is no automatic delivery endpoint.

turnaround.typical: within 2 business days after on-chain confirmation and a complete fulfillment request that includes the transaction signature

products.description: Validate AOS-compliant agent health before deployment. Catch agents that look fine locally but silently fail in production — scores manifest, runtime services, immune loop, and physical evidence under any target directory. Conflict-free verification: no phone-home, Ed25519 attestations, and the same audit rules applied to our own tools via public governance.json.
products.limitations: Advisory health scan only — findings do not block deployment by default. Scores are based on static and runtime checks under target_dir; false negatives are possible if agents hide failures outside scanned paths.

precedents.title: Receipt-processing chain: taxi expense settlement
precedents.abstract: A four-skill automation chain removes manual entry from receipt photos via OCR, JSON handoffs, and browser automation with SSO profile reuse. One human checkpoint remains at structured-data confirmation.

precedents.title: Reconciliation chain: CRM opportunity sync to Excel
precedents.abstract: A four-skill automation chain removes manual CRM field transcription into Excel via DOM extraction, Shadow DOM traversal, SSO profile reuse, and weekly summary regeneration.

precedents.title: Quality-gate chain: agent skill planning and multi-stage automation
precedents.abstract: A five-skill automation chain removes manual skill planning, implementation, and ad-hoc quality review via static analysis loops, dynamic eval loops, and a pre-release security gate. Human intervention is limited to intent capture and completion confirmation.
